A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] occurred in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].

This battle took part of the offensive planned by [[reborn]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to reconquer the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. These assaults were executed by the reunified [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] and loyal Imperial forces prior to the launch of [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. Following the [[Second Battle of Coruscant|fall of Coruscant]], [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]] was charged to reconquer the northern part of the Core. This battle allowed the Empire to control [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].
